name: Match / Clear
subtitle: Trigger elimination and chain feedback through matching rules; create rhythm and strategic space with minimal rules.
demoRuleHint: Rule: swap/click → form ≥3 identical → eliminate → fall/replenish → chain (optional)
problemsSolved: Increase decision density with the shortest feedback cycle (every move yields a result).
Use chains to create rhythmic peaks and pursue objectives.
Generate explainable board management through spatial constraints and replenishment mechanics.
learningGoals: Understand how matching conditions produce immediate feedback.
Master how chains alter rhythm and strategic priorities.
Be able to build a playable demo with minimal rules.
minimalRules: Match determination: what counts as 'identical', how to form a group (≥3 / line / L-shape, etc.).
Settlement feedback: elimination animation/sound/score (minimal can be 'disappear').
State update: falling, replenishment, blocking (minimal is 'fall + replenish').
systemLoopHint: Input (swap/click) → Judgment (group formation) → Feedback (elimination) → State change (fall/replenish) → New board → New input.

combos.effect: Map chains to resources and upgrades, creating long-term goals.
Translate elimination results into skill triggers/damage, turning into rhythmic output.
Use random drops/affixes to expand the board, creating a Roguelike match-3.

advancedWarnings: Excessive chain rewards can lead to a single strategy (only chasing chains, ignoring the board).
Tight step/time limits compress decision space, turning play into mechanical execution.
Bias in replenishment algorithms can undermine explainability (players feel 'controlled').
Reducing chain rewards can actually increase long-term strategic diversity, as players must focus on overall layout rather than a single chain.
advancedAlgoRefs: Match-3: elimination validation, chain settlement, replenishment generation strategy.
Board evaluation: eliminable detection, deadlock detection, hint generation.
